I farm 6 mu here in Quzhou. My main rotation is cabbage in spring, Chinese cabbage in autumn, then cabbage again for winter storage. I also keep a small piece for chili and a corner for kidney bean — the family eats them and I sell what's left.

I do what I did last year. For spring cabbage on about 2 mu, I use 2 bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15), that's 100 jin, plus 1 bag of urea as topdressing when heads form. Hebei soil here needs plenty of potash for good heads, my neighbor Old Wang lost a lot two years back going cheap. I water from the well maybe 6 times — cabbage drinks a lot. Bugs come bad in summer, so I spray 4-5 times.

Chinese cabbage in autumn I plant about 2 mu. Same fertilizer pattern but I add some chicken manure I buy from the chicken farm — one cart. Water 5 times, spray for worms 3-4 times.

Second cabbage (winter storage) another 1.5 mu, same way.

Chili takes 0.3 mu, I baby it — more fertilizer, more water, more spray. Kidney bean 0.2 mu, light fertilizer, beans make their own nitrogen, my father taught me that.

I plough once at start of season, then rotary before each crop. I buy improved seeds from the town dealer, hybrid costs too much but improved gives good heads.
